title: Squad
description: Defines a squad with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression systems.

name.description: The display name of the squad.

era.description: The primary era this squad is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How common or unique this squad is in the galaxy.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the squad, its role, and significance. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this squad, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this squad is viewed by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the squad.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this squad in the galaxy.

squad_leader_id.description: The ID of the Character leading the squad.

adversary_id.description: The type of minion in the squad.

count.description: Number of this type of minion in the squad.

squad_hp.description: The combined health pool of all minions in the squad.

active_formation.description: The ID of the formation the squad is currently in.

squad_actions.description: A list of special actions the leader can command the squad to take.

squad_type.description: The type of squad this is.

training_level.description: The training and experience level of the squad.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Member_Of', 'Enemy_Of', 'Allied_With', 'From'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this squad type from Star Wars canon.

famous_squads.description: Notable squads of this type from Star Wars lore.

homeworld.description: The primary homeworld or origin of this squad.

cultural_notes.description: Important cultural information about this squad.

roleplay_guidance.description: Guidance for roleplaying encounters with this squad.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements specific to this squad.

social_dynamics.description: How this squad interacts with others in the galaxy.

common_motivations.description: Common motivations and goals for this squad.

squad_development.description: Guidance for squad development and progression.

base_prompt.description: Base prompt for generating images of this squad.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different contexts and situations.

target_type.description: The type of image being generated (e.g., 'Portrait', 'Action_Shot', 'Formation_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Additional text to add to the prompt for this context.

image.description: Path to the squad image file.

icon.description: Path to the squad icon file.

color.description: Primary color associated with this squad for UI theming.
